description: This file declares external functions (API) related to the RTL8367C switch's miscellaneous features, such as MAC address management, debug info retrieval, port jam mode, and maximum length configuration. It contains only function prototypes, macro guards, and includes a related driver header.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicDebugInfo
methods.description: Fetches debug information for a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Configures jam mode on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Retrieves current jam mode configuration for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Sets the maximum length configuration identified by cfgId.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Gets the maximum length configuration by cfgId.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Sets maximum length parameters for a port and type.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves maximum length parameters for a port and type.
